Underwriting Guidelines:
• Personal and Advertising Injury Exclusion: Coverage for personal and advertising
injury (such as libel, slander, or copyright infringement in advertising) is excluded due to
the high frequency and severity of such claims in this sector. This exclusion underscores the
importance of separate professional liability or media liability policies.
• Mandatory Errors & Omissions (E&O) Coverage for Interactive Design: Firms
offering interactive or transactional website services (e.g., e-commerce platforms, user account
management) must carry E&O insurance to address potential client losses from software errors
or security failures.
• Restriction on Use of Open-Source Code Without Proper Licensing: Web design
firms must demonstrate compliance with licensing terms for any open-source software incor-
porated into client projects. Failure to do so can lead to IP infringement claims and coverage
disputes.
